headline: Mother and 3 daughters killed in Raipura, case filed; lone son devastated
summary: A case has been filed following the tragic killing of a mother and her three daughters in Raipura, leaving their only son in shock.
details: A mother and her three daughters have been tragically killed in Raipura. The incident has sent shockwaves through the local community.
Following the discovery of the bodies, a formal case has been filed in connection with the killings. Authorities have initiated an investigation into the matter.
The lone surviving son of the family is reportedly devastated by the loss of his mother and all three sisters. The family's entire world has been shattered.
The four victims were laid to rest side by side in a somber ceremony. Many local residents attended the funeral, expressing their grief and condolences.

headline: 12 workers of banned Chhatra League arrested in Narayanganj while preparing for rally
summary: Police apprehended the individuals, identified as members of the banned student organization, as they gathered to organize a rally in Narayanganj.
details: Police in Narayanganj have arrested 12 individuals identified as workers of the banned student organization Chhatra League. The arrests occurred as the group was reportedly preparing to organize a rally in the city.

The individuals were apprehended during an operation aimed at preventing unauthorized gatherings. Authorities have not yet released further details regarding the specific charges or the nature of the planned rally.
